events.name: Wine Tasting
events.description:
Join us at Caféina for an evening of wine discovery with our exclusive Wine Tasting Nights. These special events are crafted for both connoisseurs and casual enthusiasts alike, offering a journey through vineyards from around Spain, right from the comfort of our cozy café.

Don't miss the opportunity to savour unique wines, meet fellow aficionados, and possibly discover your new favourite bottle. Reserve your spot now and let us transport your palate to the heart of Spain.

events.name: Fiestas La Marina style
events.date: Monthly - ask for the next date
events.description:
Be part of the vibrant heart of Spain at our monthly fiestas here at Caféina! These lively gatherings are a perfect way to experience the joyous spirit of a Spanish party, offering a day filled with exhilarating music, dancing, and an array of authentic Spanish delicacies.

Join us for our next fiesta and embrace a Fiesta of pure La Marina celebration, Caféina style!
